hero.description: Join thousands of businesses across Côte d'Ivoire and become part of Africa's next commerce revolution — one platform, six businesses, unified logistics, and AI-native tools.

opportunities.title: Choose your opportunity
opportunities.subtitle: Select the business category that best fits your business. Each module has its own dedicated onboarding flow tailored to it.

mart.desc: List and sell groceries, fresh produce and daily essentials to your neighbourhood — same-day dispatch built in.

food.desc: Bring your restaurant, cloud kitchen or bakery online with dine-in tables, delivery and pickup — one dashboard.

shop.desc: List your fashion, electronics and home goods on the BAKĒD marketplace. Vetted sellers, national reach, PIN-gated delivery — you focus on product, we handle discovery.

send.desc: Move parcels, freight and home shifts through the BAKĒD dispatch network. Live tracking and pricing engine baked in.

auto.desc: Sell vehicles, list your dealership or manage a fleet — with financing partners and paperwork handled for you.

immo.desc: Agents and brokers close deals faster with verified listings, digital contracts, and buyer matching powered by AI.

growth.body: BAKĒD isn't just a marketplace — it's the operating system for your business. Everything you need to sell, deliver and scale, in one place.
